assets.final_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: standalone transparent game prop illustration for the center of an ancient Chinese crafting interface, intended display about 700 x 450 pixels.
Primary request: one complete coherent group of ancient Chinese papermaking equipment, wide horizontal composition roughly 14:9. A low, wide wooden papermaking vat containing pale gray fibrous pulp; a bamboo papermaking screen and frame slightly raised above the vat so its function is unmistakable; a small tidy stack of completely blank unmarked papers beside the vat. All requested objects entirely visible with a modest transparent margin on all sides.
View: slightly elevated front three-quarter view, low equipment silhouette, clear and legible at interface scale.
Style and materials: mature detailed Chinese ink-and-light-watercolor game illustration, restrained natural colors, matte weathered wood, muted bamboo, soft cool gray pulp, warm gray-white blank paper. Refined hand-painted textures and thin natural ink definition, matching a calm mountain-pavilion workshop game. Soft consistent light from upper left. Detailed but not photographic and not cartoon or plastic.
Background: genuinely transparent alpha outside the equipment group, including gaps between objects. No room, floor, scenery, tabletop rectangle, opaque paper backdrop, decorative background, checkerboard pattern, or broad shadow haze.
Avoid: people, hands, human figures, animals, writing, letters, Chinese characters, labels, talisman markings, symbols, seals, stamps, UI panels, frame borders, gold decoration, gold color, glow, magical effects, excessive piles of objects, cropped objects. The paper stack must be blank. Draw only the requested equipment group.

visual_review.content: Low wooden vat, pale gray pulp, raised bamboo screen and blank paper stack are fully visible. No text, people, hand, symbols or UI.
visual_review.notes: A few very low-alpha pixels reach the top/bottom canvas edges; visible object bounds retain margins. The raw generated output was kept unchanged.
